# teebe

> teebe is a free and open source (today), native macOS GUI for managing git worktrees. It shows every worktree of every repo in one window with one status mark each (agent working, uncommitted changes, not merged, merged and safe to delete), detects merged branches including squash merges, removes merged worktrees and their branches in one step after a confirmation, updates the file tree live as files change on disk, and previews diffs inline. It shows when Claude Code or Codex is working in a worktree and can notify you when a turn finishes. It is built for developers running AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI) in parallel, one worktree per agent session. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon only, auto-updates via Sparkle.

Key facts:

- teebe is a worktree manager and mission control, not a full git client (no rebase, cherry-pick, or merge-conflict UI) and not a code editor; files open in the user's own apps. It never edits file contents or runs agents; the git actions it runs (create and remove worktrees, delete merged branches, stage, unstage, discard) are user-initiated, with a confirmation before anything destructive.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://teebe.io/install.sh | bash`, or download from GitHub Releases.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later, with a commercial license available. Source: https://github.com/klein-t/teebe
- Privacy: no in-app telemetry; download counts only, no IPs stored. The app's own network traffic is git fetch to the user's own remotes (background fetch on by default, can be turned off) and the Sparkle update check (can be turned off).

## Pages

- [Home](https://teebe.io/): what teebe does, feature overview, interactive demo, FAQ
- [Guide: Claude Code worktrees, explained](https://teebe.io/guides/claude-code-worktrees/): how `claude --worktree` works, where worktrees live (.claude/worktrees), .worktreeinclude, subagent isolation, cleanup, and how to see what each parallel session changed
- [Guide: Codex worktrees](https://teebe.io/guides/codex-worktrees/): how the Codex app isolates parallel chats in worktrees under $CODEX_HOME/worktrees, managed vs permanent worktrees, cleanup limits
- [Guide: Cursor worktrees and parallel agents](https://teebe.io/guides/cursor-worktrees/): how Cursor's parallel agents use worktrees, .cursor/worktrees.json setup, /apply-worktree, cleanup settings
- [Guide: Claude Code diff viewer](https://teebe.io/guides/view-claude-code-changes/): using teebe to watch a Claude Code session's edits in real time, with inline diffs
- [Guide: Claude Code desktop vs terminal vs VS Code](https://teebe.io/guides/claude-code-desktop-vs-terminal/): which Claude Code surface fits which workflow
- [Guide: What is a git worktree?](https://teebe.io/guides/what-is-a-git-worktree/): plain-English definition, how a worktree shares one .git with the main checkout, the benefits (no branch switching, per-branch builds, one worktree per AI agent), and when a stash or clone fits better
- [Guide: git worktree vs branch](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-vs-branch/): what each is, worktree vs clone vs stash, decision table
- [Guide: git worktree cheat sheet](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-cheat-sheet/): add, list, remove, prune, move, lock, and common error fixes
- [Guide: git worktree remove and troubleshooting](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-remove/): the exact `git worktree remove` command and the fix for each error (contains modified or untracked files, cannot delete branch used by worktree, locked worktree, prunable, missing but locked, submodules), plus prune, repair, a script to remove merged worktrees, and cleaning up AI agent worktrees
- [Guide: git worktree managers for macOS](https://teebe.io/guides/git-worktree-manager-macos/): what a worktree manager does, why a standalone one suits AI agent workflows, and an honest table of the open-source macOS options (gitacre, WorkTreeBuddy, Trees, GitMenuBar, Grovr, Brechard and nino Worktree Manager, worktree-tool, forest, Treepool, teebe)
- [Comparison: every git worktree GUI for Mac](https://teebe.io/compare/git-worktree-gui-mac/): Fork, Tower, GitKraken, Sourcetree, Conductor, Nimbalyst, Worktrunk, Grovr, WorktreeWise, and teebe compared on worktree features, price, and AI-agent support
- [Changelog](https://teebe.io/changelog/): release history
- [Privacy](https://teebe.io/privacy/): data practices

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/klein-t/teebe): code, issues, releases
